name: HOME_CARE_VISIT_SET_ORDER
description: Home care visit set Information. This table contains home care order (LVO) specific information for visit sets.

columns.name: VISIT_SET_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the visit set record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: VERBAL_ORDER_ID
columns.description: Stores the home care order (LVO) ID for the visit set.

columns.name: VERBAL_ORDER_SUPPRESS_C_NAME
columns.description: This stores whether a user decided to not create an order for the visit set or the visit set was discontinued upon discipline discharge.

columns.name: VISIT_AUTH_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Auth status for the visit set

columns.name: ACTION_VISIT_LVO_C_NAME
columns.description: The action taken on the visit set which led to the creation of the order.
